approval.basis: User continued the female day product breakdown and GitHub handoff workflow with the street editorials.

copy.captionEn: Different shades of brown. One bold pattern.
copy.introKo: 스웨이드의 매트한 표면과 그래픽 팬츠의 큰 패턴을 한 색 계열로 묶어요. 크림 니트를 사이에 두고 화이트 스니커즈로 발끝을 밝히면, 브라운 숄더백까지 자연스럽게 이어져요.
copy.introEn: Bring matte suede and a large trouser pattern together through shades of brown. A cream knit and white sneakers lighten the composition, while a chocolate shoulder bag keeps it connected.
copy.introDe: Verbinde matte Wildlederoptik und ein großes Hosenmuster durch verschiedene Brauntöne. Cremefarbener Strick und weiße Sneaker hellen den Look auf; eine schokoladenbraune Schultertasche führt die Palette fort.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 안쪽 레이어가 보이게 입어요. 소매와 밑단의 볼륨을 자연스럽게 남겨주세요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to reveal the inner layers, keeping the natural volume of sleeves and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit die inneren Lagen sichtbar bleiben, und lasse Ärmeln und Saum ihr natürliches Volumen.
products.altKo: 브라운 스웨이드 재킷 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: warm brown suede-look zip-front collared short jacket, relaxed cut, spread collar, subtle horizontal chest panel seams, front pockets, matte tactile nap

products.descriptionKo: 아우터 안에서 니트의 표면을 보여줘요. 밑단을 정돈해 와이드 하의의 여유를 살려요.
products.descriptionEn: Show the knit texture beneath the jacket and keep the hem neat above the wide trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige die Strickstruktur unter der Jacke und ordne den Saum über der weiten Hose.
products.altKo: 크림 크루넥 니트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: plain cream fine-knit crewneck long sleeve sweater, ribbed neck cuffs hem, relaxed fit, hidden portions conservative

products.descriptionKo: 큰 그래픽 패턴을 브라운 재킷과 같은 계열로 연결해요. 크림 니트는 단색으로 두어 패턴이 잘 보이게 해요.
products.descriptionEn: Link the large graphic pattern to the brown jacket and keep the cream knit plain so the print stands out.
products.descriptionDe: Verbinde das große Grafikmuster mit der braunen Jacke und halte den cremefarbenen Pullover schlicht, damit das Muster wirkt.
products.altKo: 브라운 그래픽 와이드 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: wide-leg brown trousers with large dark chocolate abstract botanical/geometric leaf-like sweeping shapes over tan-brown ground, match reference exact large-scale print mood and colors; full pair

products.descriptionKo: 와이드 하의 아래 앞코와 솔이 드러나게 밑단 길이를 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Set the trouser length so the toe and sole remain visible beneath the wide leg.
products.descriptionDe: Wähle die Hosenlänge so, dass Spitze und Sohle unter dem weiten Bein sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 화이트 코트 스니커즈 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair white low-top leather-look court sneakers, white flat soles, tonal side panels and white laces, minimalist unbranded

products.descriptionKo: 몸 가까이 걸쳐 실루엣을 간결하게 정리해요. 스트랩은 겉옷 위에서 자연스럽게 이어줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Carry close to the body for a clean silhouette, letting the strap sit naturally over the outer layer.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Tasche nah am Körper und lasse den Riemen natürlich über der äußeren Lage liegen.
products.altKo: 초콜릿 숄더백 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE dark chocolate brown smooth leather-look medium shoulder bag with single long shoulder strap, soft rounded body resting under arm/hip in reference, hidden back conservative

products.descriptionKo: 니트 위로 작은 펜던트만 드러내요. 가는 체인으로 목선의 레이어를 가볍게 이어줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the small pendant sit over the knit, keeping the neckline light with a fine chain.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse den kleinen Anhänger über dem Strick liegen und halte den Ausschnitt mit einer feinen Kette leicht.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 펜던트 네크리스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE delicate gold-tone fine chain with very small rounded coin pendant as visible over cream knit, only necklace

products.descriptionKo: 작은 후프로 얼굴 가까이에 은은한 포인트를 더해요. 목걸이와 비슷한 금속 톤으로 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a subtle accent near the face with small earrings, keeping the metal tone coordinated.
products.descriptionDe: Setze mit kleinen Ohrringen einen dezenten Akzent am Gesicht und stimme den Metallton ab.
products.altKo: 미니 골드 이어링 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair tiny simple gold-tone huggie/stud-like earrings based on small visible ear detail, minimal rounded form, concealed construction conservative, no extra jewelry

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, waistbands, linings, shirt/sweater bodies and opposite shoes are conservatively reconstructed.
Small jewelry forms and hidden clasps/posts are interpreted from visible details; actual metal is unknown.
Material names describe visual appearance, not verified composition. Exact temperature and feels-like values are unknown.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, shopping paper bags and keys are scene props, not outfit products.
Socks not clearly visible; not generated.
